courses.title: KS2 English & SATs Preparation
courses.subject: English
courses.summary: Reading comprehension, SPaG and writing stamina ahead of Year 6 SATs.
courses.description: Structured preparation for the KS2 reading and SPaG papers, alongside weekly extended writing to build stamina and confidence. Each session ends with a short piece of marked writing.

courses.title: KS2 Maths Foundations
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Number confidence, times tables and problem solving for Years 3-6.
courses.description: Small-group and one-to-one sessions that rebuild number confidence from the ground up. We work through the KS2 national curriculum at the pace the child needs, with plenty of practical apparatus and low-stakes practice.

courses.title: KS3 Maths (Years 7-9)
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Bridging primary arithmetic into algebra, ratio and geometry.
courses.description: The KS3 years are where gaps quietly open up before GCSE. This course covers the full Year 7-9 programme of study, with diagnostic checks each half term so we can go back over anything that has not stuck.
topics: Negative numbers and order of operations
Angles in parallel lines and polygons

courses.title: KS3 Science (Years 7-9)
courses.subject: Science
courses.summary: Biology, chemistry and physics fundamentals with practical investigation skills.
courses.description: A single course covering all three sciences at KS3, with an emphasis on working scientifically: variables, fair tests, graphs and conclusions. Ideal preparation for setting decisions at the end of Year 9.
topics: Particle model and states of matter

courses.title: GCSE Combined Science (Trilogy)
courses.subject: Science
courses.summary: Biology, chemistry and physics content plus the required practicals.
courses.description: Covers the combined science specification including all required practicals and the maths skills that appear in the papers. We rotate across the three sciences so nothing is left until the last term.
topics: Atomic structure and the periodic table
Rates of reaction and organic chemistry

courses.title: GCSE Computer Science
courses.subject: Computer Science
courses.summary: Theory papers plus Python programming practice.
courses.description: Covers both the theory paper and the programming paper, with weekly Python exercises. Suitable for students who are strong at maths but new to writing code.
topics: CPU architecture and the fetch-execute cycle
Python: arrays, lists and file handling

courses.title: GCSE English Language
courses.subject: English
courses.summary: Paper 1 and Paper 2 technique, plus the spoken language endorsement.
courses.description: Focused work on the assessment objectives that carry the most marks: language analysis, structural analysis, comparison of viewpoints and the two writing questions. Every piece of writing is marked against the mark scheme.
topics: Paper 1 Q5: descriptive and narrative writing
Paper 2 Q5: writing to argue and persuade
Sentence variety and punctuation for effect
Timing and planning under exam conditions

courses.title: GCSE Maths (Higher Tier)
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Full Higher tier coverage with exam technique for grades 6-9.
courses.description: Complete Higher tier coverage across all exam boards, including the topics that decide grades 7-9: surds, algebraic fractions, circle theorems, vectors and iterative methods. Past paper questions every session.
topics: Quadratics: factorising, formula, completing the square

courses.title: A Level Maths
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Pure, statistics and mechanics across Years 12 and 13.
courses.description: Year 12 and Year 13 content taught alongside school, with a focus on the proof and modelling skills that students find hardest in the transition from GCSE. Includes support for the large data set.
topics: Statistical sampling and the large data set

courses.title: A Level Physics
courses.subject: Physics
courses.summary: Mechanics, fields, quantum and practical endorsement support.
courses.description: Full A Level physics content with a strong emphasis on the mathematical skills and the practical endorsement. Multi-step exam questions are broken down step by step until the method becomes automatic.
topics: Quantum phenomena and the photoelectric effect

classes.title: KS2 Maths Booster
classes.subject: Maths
classes.description: Arithmetic fluency and a weekly problem-solving challenge. Groups of no more than eight, split by year group.

classes.title: GCSE Maths Higher Clinic
classes.subject: Maths
classes.description: Bring the questions you got stuck on that week. We work them through on the board, then drill the same idea on fresh questions.

classes.title: KS2 Reading and Writing
classes.subject: English
classes.description: Comprehension practice in the first half, a piece of extended writing in the second, marked before the next week.

classes.title: GCSE Science Practical Lab
classes.subject: Science
classes.description: The required practicals, actually carried out rather than described, with the exam questions that come from each one.

classes.title: KS3 Maths and Problem Solving
classes.subject: Maths
classes.description: Keeps Year 7 to 9 ahead of the school scheme of work, with UKMT junior challenge questions once a month.

classes.title: GCSE English Language Workshop
classes.subject: English
classes.description: One exam question per week, planned, written under timed conditions and marked against the mark scheme.

classes.title: A Level Maths Workshop
classes.subject: Maths
classes.description: Pure, statistics and mechanics on a rotation, pitched at the step up from GCSE in Year 12 and revision in Year 13.

classes.title: A Level Physics Problem Class
classes.subject: Physics
classes.description: Multi-step exam questions broken down on the board, then worked independently with help on hand.
